notes.title: Release 2.0
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Steam [b]Cloud Support[/b]
[*] Dungeon [b]Total damage[/b] has been added
[*] Players are now able to [b]zoom cards[/b]
[*] Boss details and level up can be checked ingame now
[*] [b]New hand design[/b]: room and spell cards are visible together now and can be easily navigated
[*] Intuitive drag and drop for spell casting
[*] Brand new [b]ingame interactive tutorial[/b]
[*] [b]Highlight effects[/b] added in room building 
[*] [b]Discard pile[/b] rework and new hero dungeon carousel
[*] Room type icon has been expanded
[*] [b]Pass turn[/b] button has been added in order to skip player building
[*] Bosses will now help the players ingame by giving them hints
[*] [b]New animation[/b] for discarded cards
[*] Fixed several crashes and general issues
[/list]

Thanks for all your [i]feedback[/i]. More UI improvements will be available soon. Stay tuned!
